name: scattered messages pile up around a mark
looks: A handful of real-looking messages, a chat alert, a launch notice, a text from a colleague, drift in and settle around a small central app icon, each slightly offset and rotated, none quite overlapping the mark itself.
build: Message cards are DOM panels with kit.rng-seeded offset x/y/rotation, staggered entrance 10-30% uneven on a spring, same mechanic as variant-stack-reveal, settling around a fixed central icon.
sound: A soft cluster of hits as the messages land, one per card.
prompt: Let a handful of real-looking messages, a team chat alert, a launch notice, a note from a colleague, drift in and settle unevenly around a small central app icon, each offset and slightly rotated, to show the scattered noise one product is meant to replace.
